For Delhi, I’d shortlist these budget-friendly loose-leaf subscriptions:

Option	Cost	Trade-off
Dharmsala Tea Co.	₹1,200/6 deliveries (~₹200 each)	Cheapest; fresh garden teas, but assortment is curated/surprise rather than fully customised. 
Dharmsala Tea Company
+1

Dharmsala Tea Co. 12-pack	₹2,100/12 (~₹175 each)	Best value if you’re committing for a year; less flexibility if your tastes change. 
Dharmsala Tea Company

Luxmi Estates	₹545/month starting point	Better control: choose teas; 10% off for 3 months, 15% for 6, 20% for 12. Smaller packs can mean higher ₹/gram. 
luxmiestates.in

My pick: Dharmsala 12-delivery if you want maximum value and enjoy discovering new teas. Luxmi if you already know your preferred flavours.
